description: This file defines the 'Sale' class, which extends a basic object and represents a sales record in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for creating list queries, filling in additional fields, and saving records, along with class properties for amount in USD and currency ID.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Represents a sales record, extending the Basic class with properties for amount in USD and currency, and methods for querying, filling fields, and saving.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Constructs a new list query with special handling for the 'amount_usdollar' filter. Delegates to the parent method.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Ensures the 'amount_usdollar' field is populated if 'amount' is available, called after retrieving list data.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Ensures the 'amount_usdollar' field is populated if 'amount' is available, called after retrieving detail data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Converts 'amount' to USD if a currency is set and saves the record, delegating to the parent save method.
